---
name: legacy-code-discovery
description: "Investigate legacy Java application behaviour and dependencies."
---
# Procedure

Inspect Ant targets, EAR/WAR descriptors, source/config/JAR manifests. Trace UI-to-integration paths and data/transaction ownership. Inventory actual Spring version, WAS9 fix pack, Java distribution, Hibernate 2/3 module boundaries, JDBC selection and JAR class loading. Reference paths and symbols; report dynamic wiring uncertainty. Produce impact-analysis.md.

# Contract

Read docs/STACK.md and the selected change inputs. Preserve source/requirement references. Persist outputs to changes/CHANGE-ID. Use templates where relevant. Do not modify controls or self-approve. Report blockers with the decision needed and affected artifacts.
